'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Cole Mayer DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Mayer]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
